exit_load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year
tax_implications: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
fund_description: The scheme seeks to generate long term capital appreciation/income by investing in equity & equity related instruments of up to 30 companies.
